name: Xu Meng Ru Ju
overview: On the night of Crown Prince Wu Shuo's wedding, the goddess Su Li, clad in her wedding gown, casts three divinations—each foretelling disaster: a kidnapping, a death in the family, and the fall of her beloved. Faced with this deadly predicament, she vows to forge a path to survival. When her former lover, General Gu Huai, crashes the ceremony, the two become entangled in a deadly conspiracy. Bound by love and fate, they must fight through danger to uncover the truth and save the realm.
